project.title: HeyPCB ESP32-S3 Sensors 2: Motion, Magnetic, Optical & Power
project.summary: 50 ESP32-S3 boards, one sensor each: IMUs, accelerometers, magnetometers, Hall and angle sensors, distance, touch, optical and current monitors. KiCad 10, JLCPCB-ready, CERN-OHL-S-2.0.
